skills.name: ai-dev-kit
skills.description: Skill-first development discipline for GitFlow loop work, document synchronization, test review, multi-agent review, and merge readiness.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-loop
commands.description: Reserve loop work and prepare a dev-based worktree.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-preflight
commands.description: Run preflight gate and required review agents.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-test-review
commands.description: Review changed tests as untrusted evidence.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-doc-review
commands.description: Synchronize docs, ledgers, registry, and code facts.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-merge-guardian
commands.description: Decide whether a branch may merge back to dev.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-player-review
commands.description: Request or perform an independent player's-eye review of a player-visible change.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-clean
commands.description: Evidence-gated subtraction pass to remove loop-accumulated garbage.

commands.name: ai-dev-kit-cascade-init
commands.description: Set up a Git task center and optional AutoSeek web access; route project-ID joining and visualization to their dedicated skills.

commands.name: cascade-center-agent
commands.description: Join a project with its ID and model level, then check product Git access.

commands.name: cascade-flow
commands.description: Open an existing team task flow or start a local read-only Git viewer.
